metadata.scenario: A business calls to dispute additional charges on their internet service bill. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, my name is Thomas White. I'm calling about some additional charges on my internet service bill. I see. I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me more about the charges you're disputing? Yes, it looks like I've been charged for services I didn't authorize, and I want to get this sorted out. Absolutely, Thomas. Could you provide me with the details of the charges? Sure, there are two charges for premium services that I didn't sign up for. They total around $50. I understand. Let me take a moment to pull up your account and review those charges. Thank you, I appreciate it. I'm just really frustrated because I rely on my internet for work and personal needs. I completely understand how important that is. One moment, please... Okay, I see the charges here. It looks like they were applied after a promotional period ended. But I never agreed to those additional services! I was told the promotional price would continue. I’m sorry for the confusion, Thomas. Let’s work together to address this. I can escalate this to our billing department for further review. Would you like me to do that? Yes, please. I want to make sure this is resolved quickly. Perfect. I’ll get that started. Can I have your account number for verification? Sure, it's 123456789. Thank you, Thomas. I’ll also send you a confirmation email once I have more information. That would be great. Is there anything else I can assist you with while I have you on the line? Actually, I’m looking for home healthcare services for my mother with Alzheimer's. We can certainly help with that. We offer specialized dementia care and respite services. Oh, really? Can you tell me more about those services? Yes, our Dementia and Alzheimer's Care is $32-$40 per hour. We provide companionship and assistance with daily activities. That sounds good. And what about respite services? Respite Care is $30-$38 per hour, providing temporary relief for family caregivers. I see. I’d like to get more information about that. Absolutely, I can set you up with our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen. Yes, please. I’ll have Lisa reach out to you. Can I get your preferred contact number? It’s the same, +13165558962. Great! I’ll make sure she contacts you shortly. Thank you for your help, Margaret. You’re welcome, Thomas. We’ll take care of everything for you. I appreciate it. Have a great day! You too! Goodbye!
